content: Task ledger update: Hermes Discord gateway readiness slash command implemented. Added read-only /gateway action:activation_check to the Annunimas Discord bot. The command summarizes Hermes Agent gateway readiness in the work-stream operating room: safe-local status, live-ready status, work-stream registration, receipt adapter presence, gateway running status, and blockers. It does not start services, mutate credentials, or send external Discord messages. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-hermes -p annunimas-cli; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes_agent_gateway_activation_check -- --nocapture.
